title: Payment-Record Count for Home Comfort Financing Returned-Payment Fees
content:
**Rule (Home Comfort Financing).** The returned-payment payment-record count follows how the borrower pays: when autopay is enrolled it counts the autopay drafts posted less than 12 whole months before the date of handling, less the returned payments posted in that time; when autopay is not enrolled but autopay drafts were posted in that time, the borrower having just left autopay, it counts only the payments other than autopay drafts posted in that time, less the returned payments; otherwise it counts every payment posted in that time, less the returned payments.

## Which payments are counted

| Autopay on the account today | Autopay drafts posted in the last 12 whole months | Payments counted (before the returned payments are taken off) |
|---|---|---|
| enrolled | any | the autopay drafts only |
| not enrolled | one or more | only the payments other than autopay drafts |
| not enrolled | none | every payment |

An *autopay draft* is a payment drawn under the borrower's standing automatic-payment authorization; one-time online bank payments, debit card payments, checks and phone payments are payments other than autopay drafts. In every row, the returned payments posted in the same 12 whole months are then taken off the payments counted.

## Cases (hypothetical accounts, last 12 whole months)

1. Autopay enrolled; 10 autopay drafts and 2 one-time debit card payments posted; 1 returned payment. Count: 10 less 1, that is 9.
2. Autopay turned off two months ago; 9 autopay drafts and 2 online payments posted; 1 returned payment. Count: 2 less 1, that is 1.
3. Never on autopay; 11 payments by check and debit card; no returned payment. Count: 11.
